content: Omuliko wa Jesu
Cwale Jesu aba ana kwiyala Emebo No Kukena, sebeli ouka ku Jodani, mi sebeli otwaliwa ku Mebo ku lihaupa,
sebeli oka ikalamo mu lihalaupa amaywaa makumi anee, yo etekiwa kwa Diyabulosi. Kasi kulya esilya mu maywaa awo, amaywaa awo aba ana kubwa, sebeli oyomba.
Odiyabulozi sebeli wamba kwa Jesu nji, “Nji uli mwana Nyambe, olaele amawee aa nji afutuke esinkwa.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli omutambula nji, “Kame ku n̄olilwe nji, ‘Omunu katamba kuyoya ba sinkwa feela.’ ”
Cwale Diyabulozi sebeli omutwala aba kulumbiile niku mumonisa emibuso yonje no litunga mu nako eyeyo.
Odiyabulozi sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Kwa wene kame sa ni kube amaata onje ni kanya yawo yonje, kakuli yonje eye kame ina ibiwi, mi kame niiba kwa woyo ni singa.
Nji wene, cwale, kame soni lapele, yonje kame saitende yowe.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli omutambula nji, “Kame ku n̄olilwe nji, ‘Olapele Mbumu Nyambe wowe ni ku sebeleza yonyene feela!’ ”
Kame sebeli omutwala mu Jelusalema nuukamu beeka ba monngola no Ndoo ya Nyambe, ni kwamba kwa yonyene nji, “Nji uli Mwana Nyambe, oku kondele banji wenyene okutunda bano,
kakuli kame ku n̄olilwe nji, ‘Nyambe mba laele amangeloi aye nji aku sileleze.’
Mi ‘Ba maoko oo mba kwakele nji cwale amakondo owe aulwe oukulemeka ku liwee.’ ”
Cwale Jesu sebeli omutambula nji, “Kame ku n̄olilwe nji, ‘Ku twese okweteka Ombumu Nyambe wowe.’ ”
Cwale Diyabulosi aba ana kumana oku mweteka mu mikwa yonje, sebeli otunda kwa yonyene, oku twala ba nako injili.
Jesu yo Tateka Omusebezi Waye mu Galileya
Cwale Jesu sebeli oukela ku Galileya mu maata no Mebo, mi elibubo lyaye sebeli lita okakeela mu maneku onje no naha.
Cwale sebeli oiyeta mu tindoo too no milapelo ni kububekwa ku munu yonje.
Jesu yo Kaniwa mu Nazaleta
Cwale sebeli oiya mu Nazaleta, omu ana kulitiwa, mi sebeli ota mu ndoo no milapelo kanyi omo ana kwikalela omukwa waye ba liywaa no Pumulo. Sebeli oimana okubala
mi omo sebeli obiwa ebuka no munuhi Isaya. Yonyene sebeli ofukula ebuka ni kuwana aba ku n̄olilwe nji,

content.text: “Emebo ya Mbumu kame ili beulu yange,
kakuli nani kete oku kutaza eliywi no kuwaba kwaa ashebile.
Kame anani tumu oku kutaza etukuluho no awo ali mu ukoba
mi naambe omwaka ona kupumenenwa wa Mbumu.”

content: Cwale Jesu sebeli ofuka ebuka, ni ku yuusa ku mubika, mi sebeli oikala banji. Amiyo no awo onje ana kwikala mu ndoo no milapelo sebeli amwaliketa.
Cwale sebeli otangisa okwamba kwa onyene nji, “Balelo elin̄olo eli nali iyatetetwa, me mu kuyupela.”
Cwale onje sebeli aamba wino eyaye, ni ku komoka amaywi aye no musa ana ku tunda mu kanwa kaye, sebeli aamba nji, “Kana wuyu, kasa yokame Mwana Josefa?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Luli mba mu nambele enguli eyi, ‘Onganga, oku balise wenyene.’ Eyo tuna yupu ona tende mu kapenauma, witende ngeeso ni muno mu naha yowe.
Cwale sebeli wamba nji, “Niti luli kame nimyambela nji, kakwisa omunuhi okutekiwa mu naha yaye.

Kono niti luli, kame nimyambela nji kame kuna kwikalanga ambakati no kupula mu Isilaele mu maywaa a Eliya, abo eliwilu aba lina ku fukiwa mu myaka yaatu ni tikweti mutanu ni kamweya, mi kame kuna kwikala elishebo linene mu naha yonje.
Cwale Eliya kasiku tumiwa ku munu yonje kono konji feela kwa Zalefasi, mu naha no Sidoni ku mukati no mbakati.
Mi kame kuna kwikalanga asimbingwa no kupula mu Isilaele mu nako ya munuhi Elisha, mi kakwisa woyo ona kubalisiwa, kono konji feela Naamani Omusiliya.”
Cwale aba ana kuyupa eyi, onje mu ndoo no milapelo sebeli atweba.
Cwale sebeli aimana ni ku mucita mu mulenen̄i, ni ku mutwala ba lin̄ope no lilundu elyo ana ku yakela omulenen̄i woo, nji amu kwisete kunji.
Kono sebeli waabita mukaci koo nuukutela.
Omulume ona Kwikala ni Mebo no Kwiiba
Cwale Jesu sebeli ota ku Kapenauma, omulenen̄i no Galileya, mi na kwaaiyeta ba liywaa no Pumulo.
Cwale kame ana ku komoka onene etuto yaye, kakuli amaywi aye kame ana kwikala ni maata.
Mi mu ndoo no milapelo kame kuna kwikala omulume osi mebo no kwiiba, cwale sebeli okuwa ni liywi no kuneneba nji,
“Etaba yetu ni wene ibine, Jesu no Nazaleta? Kame oneeyi muku tusinya? niku limukile nji tiwe anyine, tiwe no Kukena wa Nyambe!”
Kono Jesu sebeli omukalimela nji, “Ondoka, mi otunde mwa yonyene!” Mi cwale emebo aba inaku mukwiseta banji mukaci no aanu, cwale sebeli itunda mwa yonyene eyulwile okumutenda esi no kwiiba.
Cwale onje sebeli akomoka nuukwambisa omunjili ku munjili nji, “Eliywi eli libine? Kame ali ni tukelo ni maata no ku laelela emebo no kwakena, mi kame itunda!”
Cwale elibubo lyaye sebeli lita mu ibaka yonje itingulukile enaha eyo.
Jesu yo Balisa Aanu no Kupula
Jesu sebeli otunda mu ndoo no milapelo, ni kwingena mu ndoo ya Simoni. Njemunwa Simoni yo langanine yotomine onene elitomapa, mi sebeli aamba eyaye kwa Jesu.
Cwale Jesu sebeli oimana ku nyonga yaye ni ku kalimela litomapa, mi sebeli litunda mwa yonyene, cwale ababo sebeli oinguka ni kwaa sebeleza.
Cwale eliywaa aba lina kwiika, onje awo ana kwikalanga naanu no meeti no oukusiya-siya sebeli aalita kwa Jesu, mi sebeli wabeeka amaoko aye beulu ni kwaabalisa.
Cwale emebo no kupula no kwiiba sebeli itunda, eyi kuwa nji, “Tiwe Mwana Nyambe!” Kono Jesu sebeli oikalimela, ni kwilaela nji ilese okwamba, kakuli naiku limuka nji yokame Kilesite.
Jesu yo Kutaza mu Tindoo no Milapelo
Cwale eliywaa aba lina kupa, Jesu sebeli ofunduka ni kuta okaikala mu sibaka yomboci. Mi aanu sebeli amusaela ni kwiiya kwa yonyene nji amu kanise okwasiya.
Kono sebeli waatambula nji,“Kame nifanena okakutaza eliywi no kuwaba no mubuso wa Nyambe mu milenen̄i injili ngeeso, kakuli sokame eso ina tumenwe.”
Cwale sebeli okutaza mu tindoo no milapelo mu Judeya.
